snippet.title: What's Hot in the New DEMO? | Free Demo Updated
snippet.description:
Choppy Cuts Free Demo( ver 0.5.15) is now available on Steam! Come and check out our new branches, new crew, online CO-OP and new challenge system！

Don't forget to add us to your Steam Wishlist and follow our social media for all the latest updates.
We'd love to hear your experiences and feedback in our official communities as we embark on this exciting journey together! Happy styling!
